Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for the call earlier — great to hear more about Helius’ roadmap and the low-latency requirements for your clinical summarization pipeline. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

- Goals we discussed: predictable 99th%-ile latency under 350ms, multi-region failover, and a pilot on mixed-precision fine-tuned models by Q4.
- Stakeholders to include on the technical deep dive: you (Sam), Priya (ops), your infra lead (TBD), and our runtime engineer (Ben).

Scheduling: to keep things inclusive for APAC, EU, and US stakeholders, we recommend a rotating demo cadence — one week we host at an earlier US window to accommodate APAC late mornings, the next week we move the demo time toward an EU-friendly middle-of-day, and then a US-late/EMEA-morning swap. This prevents the same people always taking the odd hours.

Proposed rotating slots (pick two that work and we’ll publish a recurring calendar invite):
- Option A (US morning / APAC late): Mon 10:00 PT / Tue 01:00 AEST (60 min)
- Option B (EU midday / US evening): Tue 16:00 CET / Tue 10:00 PT (60 min)
- Option C (APAC morning / EU late morning): Wed 09:30 SGT / Wed 03:30 BST (60 min)

If none of those fit, send 2x 1-hour windows that work for your core attendees and we’ll rotate accordingly.

Attaching a short mutual action plan + pre-demo questionnaire to help scope the deep dive (I’ve also included a few items we’ll demo: routing policies, KV prefix caching, and a quick cost/latency tradeoff example).

Next steps: can you confirm the two preferred windows and the list of internal attendees? I’ll loop in Ben for the deep technical sections.

Thanks —
Hannah
